lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular spots of varying diameters, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges are visible running horizontally along the flank, each marked by a sharp vertical gradient transition with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Very low density; only two to three isolated, low-contrast, high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, high-intensity cyan/blue pixel cluster is visible near the base of the second dorsal fin, indicating a potential tag or parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, more uniform high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced blobs on the primary lateral flank.
